summary: The source contract permits at most 100 queue-method calls, and aggregate stack-operation accounting proves O(1) amortized time without an honest unbounded workload.

workload_bound.unit: push, pop, peek, and empty calls
workload_bound.source_constraint: The source-fidelity-verified constraint permits at most 100 calls across all four queue methods.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each pushed value enters incoming once, moves to outgoing at most once, and leaves outgoing at most once. Thus q calls perform O(q) total stack operations, proving O(1) amortized time per call; one transfer may take O(n), and storage is O(n).
Black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary command stream without inspecting its definition, including FIFO observations, lazy transfers, and legal reuse of the queue.
